title: docs(spec): the blueprint widget aggregate describes say a widget with a measure and no aggregate may be refused, not defaulted
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoQE5JiKcyDY5fdamKwvANk5)_

Fixes #30667

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Describe text only; both schemas accept exactly what they accepted before. Rulings carried verbatim from the card and triage 6683636257: "Both describes say what a reader may do when `aggregate` is absent on a widget that names a measure: it may refuse the widget. They must not promise a default." · "The strict mirror's `null` stays legal for a count widget, and the describe says so." · "Describe text only. No schema change, so no ledger row moves."

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：蓝图看板组件 `aggregate` 键的两处说明（宽松 schema 与设计模型实际读取的严格镜像）不再说"不写就用读取方自己的默认值"，改为同一句共享规则：写了 `measure` 却没写 `aggregate` 的组件不完整，读取方可以拒收，不承诺任何默认聚合；只有不写 `measure` 的计数组件可以不写。严格版补一句 `null` 对计数组件仍合法。参考页随之再生成。
- **为什么改**：按你在 cloud#3607 的裁决 B，cloud 已拒收这种组件；而 cloud 的设计模型正对着严格版说明生成蓝图，旧文字会教它写出会被拒收的组件。
- **风险与回滚**：零运行时、零 schema 改动，接受集不变；回滚即 revert。
- **先看**：`packages/spec/src/ai/solution-blueprint.zod.ts` 新常量 `WIDGET_AGGREGATE_UNSET_RULE` 及两条 `aggregate` describe；`solution-blueprint.test.ts` 新增的一条 pin。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/ai/solution-blueprint.test.ts`，预期 98/98 通过，其中新 pin 断言两边都不再出现"默认"承诺、都写明"may refuse it"、严格版写明计数组件可为 null。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **One shared rule, read on both sides.** A new constant `WIDGET_AGGREGATE_UNSET_RULE` in `packages/spec/src/ai/solution-blueprint.zod.ts`, beside `WIDGET_AGGREGATE_MEANING` and in the voice of `WIDGET_MEASURE_RULE`: "SET it on every widget that names a `measure`: a widget that names a `measure` and leaves this unset is incomplete, and a reader may refuse it; no default aggregation is promised. Only a count widget, which names no `measure`, may leave it unset."
  - Lenient widget `aggregate`: was "…SET it on every widget that aggregates; omitted, the reader falls back to a default of its own, which may not be the average or extreme a widget means." Now `MEANING` + the shared rule.
  - Strict mirror `aggregate`: was "How the widget aggregates its records, or null for the reader's own default. … Write it, never null, on every widget that aggregates." Now "How the widget aggregates its records, or null on a count widget whose `measure` is null." + `MEANING` + the shared rule.
- **Pin**, in the existing `blueprint widget aggregate and calendar view startDateField` describe of `solution-blueprint.test.ts` (shared-harness rule: a new top-level `it`, no new file): neither `aggregate` describe matches the default promise (`reader's own default`, `default of its own`, `falls back`), both say "may refuse it", and the strict one says "null on a count widget". The strict describe is the text the design model generates against, so its wording is what the consumer reads.
- **Regenerated**: `content/docs/references/ai/solution-blueprint.mdx` (1 line, the lenient row), by `gen:docs` after `check:generated` named it stale; not hand-edited. The strict mirror is not exported, so it has no reference row.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/30667-blueprint-widget-aggregate-unset-may-refuse.md`: `@objectstack/spec` patch, both declaration lines at line start.

Other copies of the promise on `origin/main` 26c965cb: `grep -rn "reader's own default\|reader falls back to a default of its own" packages skills content` → the two describes and the generated reference row only. Nothing under `skills/**`, so the PR stays default tier, not governed.

## Tests

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/ai/solution-blueprint.test.ts`: `Tests 98 passed (98)`.
- Reverse verification of the new pin, fix committed first: `solution-blueprint.zod.ts` restored tree-only from `origin/main` 26c965cb (old wording 1 hit, `WIDGET_AGGREGATE_UNSET_RULE` 0 hits on disk), same run under the lock → VERDICT command-exit 1, `Tests 1 failed | 97 passed (98)`, the failing test being the new pin. Restored with `git checkout HEAD -- PATH`: `git hash-object` equals the HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` and `git status --porcelain` empty.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck` under the lock: VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test` under the lock: VERDICT command-exit 0, `Test Files 818 passed (818)`, `Tests 25839 passed | 1 todo (25840)`. `test:repo` (the vitest `repo` project) is CI's run (`Test Core`), not run here.

## Verification

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build` (dts 38/38 emitted), then `check:generated`: 1 artifact stale (`content/docs/references/**`), regenerated with `gen:docs`; rerun → "All 14 generated artifacts are up to date", exit 0. The first `check:generated` run also reported `check:test-typecheck` as "tsc failed without diagnostics" under the default heap; `check:test-typecheck` alone with `--max-old-space-size=4096` → exit 0 ("52 file(s) / 240 error(s) / 131 pinned signature(s) held"), and the rerun of `check:generated` with that heap is the green one above. Nothing was re-recorded.
- Gate families derived against the actual diff with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at 0e0ae5d9 (the final commit): 103 lines, every one run with stdin from /dev/null, exit codes landed on disk before any pipe, reconciled with `--ran`: `103 derived, 103 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`, every line exit 0 on the final tree. Seven lines first exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET, nothing measured): `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` (shallow clone; fetched its control commit, rerun exit 0, 48 cases) and six that read built output (`check:doc-formula-expressions`, `check:doc-security-posture`, `check:skill-examples`, `check:docs-transcript-drift`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure`); after `turbo run build --concurrency=2` under the lock (VERDICT command-exit 0, 119/119 tasks) each reran exit 0.
- Tier: `dispatch-gates.mjs --tier` → no path-derived mandate; not a governed surface. Changed lines 37 (+34 / -3, generated included), under the 3,000 threshold.

## Acceptance notes

- The cloud consumer (`blueprintWidgetRefusals`, rule `aggregate_missing`, objectstack-ai/cloud#3639) is quoted only as the card states it; this repo cannot read cloud. The card scopes that refusal to a non-table widget; the spec text says "may refuse", which a reader that exempts table widgets satisfies, so the describe names no chart kind.
- The `BLUEPRINT_WIDGET_AGGREGATES` docblock still says that before the key existed "the reader picked the aggregation from the field type". That is history of why the key was added, not a promise about an unset key, and is left as is.
- `measure:"count"` (the legacy record-count spelling) with `aggregate` unset is a widget that names a `measure`; the shared rule says a reader may refuse it. Whether cloud refuses that exact shape is not stated on the card and was not measured.
